reply.body: I think it is already easy to track back to this PR and this writing by looking on commit history. Would you like to include link on this PR to the comments?
I usually prefer to have all the context in the code, just a small comment would be great 👍

timeline.body: does this change make the test more stable?

             true,

-                .mapToObj(i -> client().prepareIndex(indexName).setSource("foo", randomBoolean() ? "bar" : "baz"))
+                .mapToObj(i -> client().prepareIndex(indexName).setSource("foo", randomAlphaOfLength(1048)))

reply.body:
As I tried to explain in initial PR description, I'd like to increase value of `secondsToPause = (bytes / 1024. / 1024.) / mbPerSec` ratio.

Document size (highlighted lines above) eventually translated to `bytes` param in this formula, whereas 90% of minimax goes to `mbPerSec` parameter. By increasing numerator and decreasing denominator we are getting larger value for `secondsToPause`. all these could tigger rate limiting logic more often and hence make test more stable.
